stem: In what way do the parrot’s actions in paragraph 6 affect the rising action of the story?

options.label: A
options.text: They give the beetle a reason to want a new coat.

options.label: B
options.text: They present a tempting challenge to the rat and beetle.

options.label: C
options.text: They encourage the rat and the beetle to trust the parrot.

options.label: D
options.text: They indicate that the rat will learn a lesson from the parrot.
